record.field: Statutory standard deduction allowance under Section 16(ia) for New Tax Regime (Section 115BAC). Finance Act 2024 / AY 2026-27 limit ₹75,000.
Statutory standard deduction allowance under Section 16(ia) for Old Tax Regime. Limit ₹50,000.
TDS: Sec 87A Taxable Income Limit (New Regime)
Maximum net taxable income threshold for Section 87A rebate applicability under New Tax Regime. FY 2025-26 limit ₹12,00,000.
TDS: Sec 87A Taxable Income Limit (Old Regime)
Maximum net taxable income threshold for Section 87A rebate applicability under Old Tax Regime. Limit ₹5,00,000.
Maximum tax rebate amount under Section 87A for New Tax Regime. FY 2025-26 maximum rebate ₹60,000.
Maximum tax rebate amount under Section 87A for Old Tax Regime. Maximum rebate ₹12,500.
Statutory Health & Education Cess percentage applied on total income tax and surcharge. Shared across both Old and New regimes (4%).
Finance Act 2018 establishing Health & Education Cess at 4% w.e.f. 01-Apr-2018.
Statutory employer NPS contribution deduction limit percentage under Section 80CCD(2) for New Tax Regime (14% for all employers).
Finance Act 2024 enhanced employer NPS limit to 14% under New Regime w.e.f. 01-Apr-2025.
TDS: Employer NPS Limit % (Old Regime - Private)
Statutory employer NPS contribution deduction limit percentage under Section 80CCD(2) for Old Tax Regime for Private/Other employers (10%).
Section 80CCD(2) establishing 10% limit for private sector employers under Old Regime.
TDS: Employer NPS Limit % (Old Regime - Govt)
Statutory employer NPS contribution deduction limit percentage under Section 80CCD(2) for Old Tax Regime for Central/State Govt employers (14%).
Finance Act 2019 enhanced Central/State Government employer NPS limit to 14% w.e.f. 01-Apr-2019.
TDS: Combined Employer PF + NPS + Superannuation Ceiling
Statutory annual ceiling under Section 17(2)(vii) for employer contributions to EPF, NPS, and Approved Superannuation Fund combined (₹7,50,000). Excess is treated as a taxable perquisite.
Finance Act 2020 inserted Section 17(2)(vii) establishing ₹7,50,000 aggregate annual ceiling w.e.f. 01-Apr-2020.
Maximum allowable aggregate deduction limit under Section 80C (PPF, EPF, ELSS, LIC, Tuition Fee, Principal Home Loan repayment). Old Regime ceiling ₹1,50,000.
Additional deduction for individual employee contribution to National Pension System (NPS Tier-I) under Section 80CCD(1B) over and above Section 80C (₹50,000).
TDS: Sec 80D Health Insurance Self/Family Limit
Maximum health insurance premium deduction under Section 80D for Self, Spouse, and Dependent Children (below 60 years) (₹25,000).
TDS: Sec 80D Health Insurance Self Senior Citizen Limit
Maximum health insurance premium deduction under Section 80D for Self/Spouse if Senior Citizen (60 years or above) (₹50,000).
TDS: Sec 80D Health Insurance Parents Limit
Maximum health insurance premium deduction under Section 80D for Parents (below 60 years) (₹25,000).
TDS: Sec 80D Health Insurance Parents Senior Citizen Limit
Maximum health insurance premium deduction under Section 80D for Parents if Senior Citizen (60 years or above) (₹50,000).
TDS: Sec 80D Preventive Health Checkup Sub-limit
Sub-limit for preventive health checkup within overall Section 80D limit (₹5,000).
TDS: Sec 80TTA Savings Account Interest Limit
Deduction under Section 80TTA for interest on savings bank accounts for non-senior individuals (₹10,000).
TDS: Sec 80TTB Senior Citizen Interest Limit
Deduction under Section 80TTB for interest on bank/post-office deposits for senior citizens (₹50,000).
TDS: Sec 80DD Dependent Disability Normal Limit
Deduction for maintenance/medical treatment of dependent with disability (40% to 80%) (₹75,000).
TDS: Sec 80DD Dependent Disability Severe Limit
Deduction for maintenance/medical treatment of dependent with severe disability (more than 80%) (₹1,25,000).
TDS: Sec 24(b) Self-Occupied Home Loan Interest Limit
Maximum deduction for interest payable on housing loan for self-occupied house property under Section 24(b) (₹2,00,000).
TDS: Sec 71(3A) House Property Loss Set-Off Limit
Maximum set-off of loss from house property against salary / other income under Section 71(3A) for Old Tax Regime (₹2,00,000).
TDS: Sec 80EEA Additional Home Loan Interest Limit
Additional deduction for interest on housing loan sanctioned for first-time home buyers under Section 80EEA (₹1,50,000).
Percentage of Basic Salary + Dearness Allowance considered for HRA exemption in Metro cities (Mumbai, Delhi, Kolkata, Chennai) (50%).
Income Tax Rules 1962 Rule 2A establishing 50% for Metro cities.
Percentage of Basic Salary + Dearness Allowance considered for HRA exemption in Non-Metro cities (40%).
Income Tax Rules 1962 Rule 2A establishing 40% for Non-Metro cities.
TDS: HRA Rent Excess Over Basic %
Percentage of Basic Salary + Dearness Allowance deducted from rent paid for HRA exemption calculation under Rule 2A (10%).
Income Tax Rules 1962 Rule 2A establishing 10% rent excess threshold.
TDS: Children Education Allowance Exemption Monthly Limit
Statutory monthly exemption per child under Section 10(14) for Children Education Allowance (max 2 children) (₹100/month).
Income Tax Rules 1962 Rule 2BB establishing ₹100/month per child limit.
TDS: Hostel Expenditure Allowance Exemption Monthly Limit
Statutory monthly exemption per child under Section 10(14) for Hostel Expenditure Allowance (max 2 children) (₹300/month).
Income Tax Rules 1962 Rule 2BB establishing ₹300/month per child limit.
Statutory maximum leave encashment exemption ceiling under Section 10(10AA)(ii) for non-government employees (₹25,00,000).
CBDT Notification S.O. 2276(E) w.e.f. 01-Apr-2023 increasing ceiling from ₹3 Lakhs to ₹25 Lakhs.
Maximum tax exemption ceiling under Section 10(10C) for compensation received on Voluntary Retirement (VRS) (₹5,00,000).
TDS: Sec 80EEA Property Stamp Duty Ceiling
Maximum stamp duty value of residential property allowed for Section 80EEA eligibility (₹45,00,000).
Finance Act 2019 establishing ₹45,00,000 property stamp duty ceiling.
TDS: Sec 80G Maximum Cash Donation Ceiling
Maximum cash donation allowed for deduction under Section 80G(5D) (₹2,000).
Finance Act 2017 w.e.f. 01-Apr-2017 restricting cash donations to ₹2,000.
Statutory qualifying limit percentage under Section 80G(10) (10% of AGTI).
Section 80G(10) statutory 10% ceiling of Adjusted Gross Total Income (AGTI).
Maximum deduction period permitted under Section 80E (8 consecutive assessment years).
Section 80E statutory maximum deduction period of 8 assessment years.
Permitted lender categories under Section 80E (Scheduled Bank, Financial Institution, Approved Charitable Institution).

Fixed statutory deduction for dependent normal disability (40% to 79%).
Section 80DD normal disability fixed deduction amount.
TDS: Sec 80DD Severe Disability Deduction Amount (₹)
Fixed statutory deduction for dependent severe disability (80% or more).
Section 80DD severe disability fixed deduction amount.
Minimum statutory disability percentage required for Section 80DD deduction (40%).
Statutory disability percentage threshold for severe disability (80%).
TDS: Sec 80DD Allow Only Resident Individuals
Mandates resident individual status for Section 80DD eligibility.
Mandates medical certificate presence for Section 80DD deduction.
TDS: Sec 80DD Check Certificate Expiry Date
Validates certificate expiry date for temporary disability certificates.
TDS: Sec 80U Normal Disability Deduction Amount (₹)
Fixed statutory deduction for employee own normal disability (40% to 79%).
Section 80U normal disability fixed deduction amount.
TDS: Sec 80U Severe Disability Deduction Amount (₹)
Fixed statutory deduction for employee own severe disability (80% or more).
Section 80U severe disability fixed deduction amount.
Minimum statutory disability percentage required for Section 80U deduction (40%).
Statutory disability percentage threshold for severe disability (80%).
TDS: Sec 80U Allow Only Resident Individuals
Mandates resident individual status for Section 80U eligibility.
Mandates medical certificate presence for Section 80U deduction.
TDS: Sec 80U Check Certificate Expiry Date
Validates certificate expiry date for temporary disability certificates.
TDS: Family Pension Deduction Limit (New Regime)
Statutory maximum ceiling allowance under Section 57(iia) for New Tax Regime. Limit ₹25,000 w.e.f. FY 2025-26 / FY 2026-27 (Finance Act 2024).
TDS: Family Pension Deduction Limit (Old Regime)
Statutory maximum ceiling allowance under Section 57(iia) for Old Tax Regime. Limit ₹15,000.
Income Tax Act Section 57(iia) Old Regime statutory ceiling ₹15,000.
TDS: Sec 80CCH Agniveer Corpus Fund Eligibility Percentage (Old Regime)
Section 80CCH employee contribution statutory eligibility percentage for Old Tax Regime (100%).
Finance Act 2023 w.e.f. 01-Nov-2022 establishing 100% eligibility under Section 80CCH (Old Regime).
TDS: Sec 80CCH Agniveer Corpus Fund Eligibility Percentage (New Regime)
Section 80CCH employee contribution statutory eligibility percentage for New Tax Regime (100%).
Finance Act 2023 w.e.f. 01-Nov-2022 establishing 100% eligibility under Section 80CCH (New Regime).
TDS: Sec 10(5) LTA Calendar-Year Block Period
Statutory 4-calendar-year block period designation for Section 10(5) LTA exemption.
TDS: Sec 10(5) LTA Maximum Exemption Claims Per Block
Statutory maximum journey exemption claims allowed per 4-calendar-year block period (2 journeys).
Section 10(5) LTA statutory maximum 2 journey claims per block.
TDS: Sec 10(5) LTA Previous 4-Calendar-Year Block Period
Previous 4-calendar-year block period for Section 10(5) LTA carry-forward evaluation.
TDS: Sec 10(5) LTA Air Travel Fare Statutory Ceiling
Rule 2B economy air fare national carrier statutory ceiling per journey.
Rule 2B economy air fare ceiling cap ₹50,000.
TDS: Sec 10(5) LTA Rail AC1 Travel Fare Statutory Ceiling
Rule 2B AC First Class rail fare statutory ceiling per journey.
Rule 2B AC 1st class rail fare ceiling cap ₹15,000.
TDS: Sec 10(5) LTA Public Transport Travel Fare Statutory Ceiling
Rule 2B recognised public transport travel fare statutory ceiling per journey.
Rule 2B recognised public transport fare ceiling cap ₹10,000.
